name:
Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove
Update 4.1
description:
This is an update for the game card version of the Shovel Knight game. This download does not contain the full version of the title. In order to use this update, you must have the full game card version of Shovel Knight.

Includes:
1:1 Pixel Scaling Mode, fix for games sometimes not saving under certain circumstances, if wearing an amiibo costume when speaking with Madame Meeber the dialogue prompt to change back to the default costume now begins on the No choice, and other bug fixes and improvements.
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
